You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
Based on the chest X-rays provided, which statement most accurately describes the progression of the pulmonary findings in this patient over the observed period?
A) The reticular pattern and opacities decreased symmetrically in both lungs from admission to the eighth day.
B) The reticular pattern and opacities increased in density uniformly across both lungs from admission to the second day.
C) The reticular pattern decreased more significantly in the right lung compared to the left lung from admission to the eighth day.
D) The increase in density and reticular pattern was more pronounced in the right lung from admission to the second day.
E) The reticular pattern and opacities showed no significant change from admission to the eighth day.
F) The reticular pattern decreased more significantly in the upper left lobe compared to other lung regions by the eighth day.
